input.command:
git add packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/cf-extra-routes.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(deploy-cloudflare): serve real adapter and plugin data from DB/registry instead of []

GET /api/adapters: was returning [] — now queries the built-in adapter
registry (listServerAdapters). All 10 built-in adapters (claude_local,
codex_local, http, openclaw_gateway, etc.) are registered at module init
from their packages; external adapters silently skip (FS store returns []
via try-catch). getDisabledAdapterTypes() also falls back to [] in CF.
Adapter execution routes through the sandbox bridge (sidecar), so listing
the full set is correct even for subprocess-based adapters.

GET /api/plugins: was returning [] — now queries the plugins table
(ne(status, "uninstalled")).

GET /api/plugins/ui-contributions: was returning [] — now derives
contributions from manifestJson stored in the plugins table at install time.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
